runsIn: PhantomBuster + a dedicated browser, not the FamLink website
steps: Install PhantomBuster Chrome extension on the dedicated machine.
Capture session from a secondary Facebook account inside PhantomBuster (not in this repo).
Proxy: same geography as the Facebook account.
Output fields: name, profileURL, imageURL, additionalData, friendCount if the Phantom provides it.
Webhook: POST /phantombuster/webhook with PHANTOMBUSTER_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Payload array up to ~5000 members is processed off-request.
